DateTimeOriginal.value: The publicity release is not dated. The program was on NBC from 1966 to 1969. The type of logo used on the NBC Press Release is the "second peacock", which was used by the network during the years 1962 to 1975. This would be in keeping with the timeframe the show aired on the network and also within the pre-1978 guidelines.
